description: Everything on one country, starting with a summary (headline sentence, lowest visa minimums, years to citizenship, tax system, monthly cost, safety rank, programs researched and found not to exist, and the oldest and newest verification dates). Then: visas, years from residency to permanent residency and citizenship (with legal citations), physical presence rules, foreign-income tax, banking access, property tax, cost of living (country and city), safety, healthcare and hospitals, passport power, expat index scores and tax blacklist status. Pass topics to narrow it; full profiles can be large.

country.description: Country name or slug, e.g. "Panama" or "costa-rica".
